scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,server,web -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @dnd/shared" "npm run dev -w @dnd/server" "npm run dev -w @dnd/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @dnd/shared && npm run build -w @dnd/server && npm run build -w @dnd/web
scripts.check: npm run check -w @dnd/shared && npm run check -w @dnd/server && npm run check -w @dnd/web
